title: Prepublish editorial prune gate
summary: Project iteration record for promoting duplicate, templated, or low-information hot blog copy to a prepublish hard gate while keeping automatic pruning in report:draft as the first response. AI repair remains a fallback for exceptional editorial wording issues, not the normal mechanism for producing acceptable public daily content.

validation_commands: node --test tests/unit.test.js --test-name-pattern "report:draft prunes duplicate and templated hot blogs before quality review|quality review flags duplicate or templated hot blogs as prepublish gate failures"

lessons.lesson: Repair is a fallback, not the product loop.
lessons.evidence: The accepted design requires public daily generation to prefer fewer useful hot blog items over filling the section with duplicate titles or generic repeated templates that later require repair.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep public-section quality failures anchored in deterministic generation and review tests before widening any AI repair contract.

lessons.lesson: A hard gate should still choose the least expensive valid recovery path first.
lessons.evidence: The new fixture includes duplicate and templated hot blog candidates; report:draft now prunes them and records prune counts before quality review, so acceptable output can publish without generating an AI repair task.
lessons.recommended_action: When a candidate is plausible but not publication-grade, drop it before repair unless there is enough unique evidence to rewrite it deterministically.

suggestions.issue: Hot blog generation could preserve repeated Chinese titles or templated summary copy, allowing low-information public content to become a normal AI repair workload.
suggestions.evidence: Regression tests now cover generation-side pruning, selection snapshot audit data, and quality-review hard failures for duplicate or templated auto-draft hot blogs that bypass pruning.
suggestions.suggestion: Generate concrete hot blog copy from candidate evidence, prune duplicate or templated items during report:draft, and make any remaining duplicate/template auto-draft hot blog a quality-review gate failure instead of a repair task.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Scheduled daily publishing favors concise, higher-density public sections and keeps repair reserved for true fallback scenarios.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented in draft selection, review gates, feedback ledger, quick-reference documentation, and deterministic unit tests.
validation_evidence: report:draft prunes duplicate and templated hot blogs before quality review
quality review flags duplicate or templated hot blogs as prepublish gate failures

followups.action: Apply the same prune-before-repair shape to builder and community sections when their source pools become dense enough for deterministic de-duplication.
